about_the_game:
Get ready to pull off the ultimate robbery in Heist Society, the most ambitious Fablecraft adventure yet. When the party is hired to steal a sacred artifact from filthy-rich businessman, Lord Torran Highvale, they must infiltrate an elegant soiree at his floating mountaintop home. It’s a job that requires the utmost stealth, nerves of steel, and powerful magic – but where there’s risk, there’s reward.

Mages will explore 30+ unique rooms over 3 sprawling areas of Cloudhaven Keep: pristine gardens, an elaborate mansion, and a sinister dungeon. Once at Cloudhaven Keep, Mages can go where they want, when they want, provided they don't get caught. A criminally good time is guaranteed!

INCLUDES

  • A Game Master Guide that minimizes prep

  • Voiceover, featuring the voice of Anna Prosser as Scarlett 

  • 3 XXL Animated Battlemaps with fog of war tech

  • 1 Standard Battlemap

  • 7 Animated Environments (8 Variants) 

  • 2 NPCs

  • 2 Monsters with unique abilities and SFX

  • 2 Music Tracks

  • 24 Inventory Items
